dumbbell-bench-press.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
dumbbell-bench-press.cue: Keep your shoulder blades back and down. Lower the dumbbells under control, then press without bouncing.

bent-over-dumbbell-row.name: Bent-over Dumbbell Row
bent-over-dumbbell-row.cue: Keep your back flat and brace your core. Pull the elbow toward your hip rather than shrugging.

dumbbell-shoulder-press.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
dumbbell-shoulder-press.cue: Start with wrists stacked over elbows. Press smoothly overhead while keeping ribs down.

lat-pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
lat-pulldown.cue: Lean back slightly, pull the bar toward the upper chest and control the return all the way up.

dead-bug.name: Dead Bug
dead-bug.cue: Keep your lower back gently pressed into the floor. Move opposite arm and leg slowly without losing position.

farmer-carry.name: Farmer Carry
farmer-carry.cue: Stand tall, brace your core and walk with short, controlled steps. Keep the weights close and shoulders level.
